There should be ah found it, thanks! some example blocks: `20426, 30233, 30968` just to make sure that i understand this, right now all blob-gas is burned? there is no no priority-fee like in 1559 for now (for simplicity)? There is a priority fee These are the fields of a blob transaction ``` [ chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity, r, s ] ``` well for normal gas for blob gas there is no prioritygas, you can only set max_fee_per_blob_gas, though i didnt find a block where the fee_recipient gets any of the blob-gas maybe i misunderstand Thats wierd, I think geth is setting the default minimum for the priority fee to 1 GWei There should be max_priority_fee_per_gas right but that is unrelated to blob-gas,no? max_fee_per_blob_gas is _just_ the max the sender is willing to pay, the actual price is calculated from the header, blob gas is burned

excerpts.content:
These are the fields of a blob transaction
```
[
  chain_id, 
  nonce, 
  max_priority_fee_per_gas, 
  max_fee_per_gas, 
  gas_limit, 
  to, 
  value, 
  data, 
  access_list, 
  max_fee_per_blob_gas, 
  blob_versioned_hashes, 
  y_parity, 
  r, 
  s 
]
```
